title: The reasons Siri may not work on CarPlay - Engadget
summary: Apple keeps Siri's voice activation controls under Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri (or Siri) > Talk & Type to Siri . Apple suggests turning "Siri" or "Hey Siri" off and on, and then repeating the voice-recognition setup if it's not working.
